title: ISSAA & RCAA 2022: Stellarium by Prakash A*, Samir D and Atharva P (IUCAA, Pune)
description: Stellarium is an open-source planetarium and astronomy software with photo-realistic visuals of astronomical objects and highly accurate simulation of their motions. It is one of the best educational tools for understanding the changes we see in the sky and simulating observations extending over long periods of time. We will familiarize ourselves with some of the basic functionalities of the software that will help us navigate the sky, explore the sky from different locations on Earth, and jump or cruise backward and forward in time. An accompanying worksheet (download link: https://bit.ly/ace_stellarium) contains a set of Stellarium-based activities. Performing these activities will help you use your learned skills to make various observations in Stellarium and learn some key concepts that are fundamental to observational astronomy. Please download and install Stellarium (http://stellarium.org) on your computer before the first Stellarium session.
